Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for walking us through the platform last week. We sent over the initial MSA and order form redlines (attached) — legal has two pockets of concern we want to resolve before we can proceed to signature: 1) publicity/reference rights (customer quotes, press releases, logo use, public case study) and 2) a short carve-out to the confidentiality section to allow our marketing team limited non-confidential references.

Specifically:
- We are OK with a references clause but need an approval window (7 business days) for any public-facing quote or case study; we'd like the right to review and request edits.
- We want to limit logo usage to approved assets and request a usage guide to be attached to the OF.
- For the confidentiality carve-out: allow use of non-confidential, aggregated metrics in marketing materials (no PII or contractual terms).

I've attached a redline and our suggested language as NDA_Supplement.docx. Can Redwood provide a version that incorporates an approval workflow and a statement of permitted marketing assets? Also please confirm whether Redwood requires prior written approval for press releases that mention Brightline.

Appreciate your help — cc'ing Mike (sales lead) for timeline. We're targeting an October 8 signature if possible.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Legal Operations
Brightline Systems

- Logo usage: Redwood requests Brightline provide an approved assets ZIP plus brand guidelines; we will only use approved assets and will attach the logo usage guide to the OF.
- Confidentiality carve-out: we are comfortable with a narrow marketing carve-out for non-confidential, aggregated KPIs, explicitly excluding PII, customer-specific pricing, and contract terms.

Action items I'll take:
1) Draft updated OF language and MSA appendix for the publicity/reference and confidentiality carve-out by tomorrow EOD.
2) Share internal guidance for how we handle asset approvals (who on our side signs off).
3) Confirm whether Redwood requires explicit prior approval for press releases mentioning Brightline — we will treat press releases as requiring approval under the same 7-business-day window unless Brightline prefers to waive for co-branded announcements.

Cc'ing Laura (contracts) and Rishi (legal) to review the suggested language. We'll attach a fillable logo asset checklist to the OF for logistics.

Thanks Michael — that distinction makes sense and is reasonable. To confirm the agreed approach so we can finalize the OF: 

1) Co-authored / joint press releases: 48-hour courtesy notice to Brightline with an acknowledgment of receipt is sufficient; no formal 7-business-day approval required.
2) Redwood-authored case studies, customer quotes, or press that mention Brightline by name: Brightline will have a 7-business-day review window to request redactions or factual corrections; Redwood will not publish until that window closes or edits are agreed.
3) Logo usage: Brightline to provide a single approved assets ZIP and a two-page brand guidelines PDF; both parties will sign the "Approved Asset Checklist" as an OF attachment at execution.
4) Confidentiality carve-out: include narrow language permitting aggregated, non-personal metrics for marketing with explicit exclusions (PII, pricing, contract terms).

Next steps: Laura will attach the proposed language and the asset checklist template to the revised OF and send to Ellen for signature. I will also add a DocuSign link for the order form once language is confirmed: https://docusign.com/xyz123

If this matches Brightline's expectation, please reply-all with a quick "Agreed" and we'll proceed to final redlines. Targeting signature by Oct 8.

— Soojin
